title: fix(service-storage)!: an upload link is refused at issue for a file field whose readonlyWhen holds now (#32768)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDqqDa5SijBGNapewRUK6xS)_

Fixes #32768

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches `create_upload_link` or upload links; the tool's own description and `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` carry the refusal, updated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 通过 MCP 的 `create_upload_link` 给用户要上传链接时，如果目标文件字段此刻被 `readonlyWhen` 锁住（例如报销单已审批后，发票字段只读），现在直接拒绝、不发链接，拒绝理由用的是更新接口对同一把锁的原话。引擎新增一个只读不写的判断 `judgeFieldWriteLock`，复用更新路径自己的 `readonlyWhen` 判定，存储层只调用它，不另写一套表达式求值。
- 为什么改：#32734 之后，这种情况下用户要先选文件、上传，才在页面上被告知「没有附上」。白跑一趟。现在在发链接那一步就告诉 AI 原因，AI 可以直接跟用户解释。
- 风险与回滚：收紧（BREAKING 标注）：原来能拿到链接的调用现在被拒，403 `FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`，与静态只读字段同一个错误码。附件列表（不指定字段）不受影响；没有 `readonlyWhen` 的字段不多读一次库。回滚 = revert 本 PR，用户回到「上传后被拒」的旧体验，数据不受影响。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-field-write-lock.ts`（判断本体，看它是否与更新路径同源）；`packages/services/service-storage/src/record-file-access.ts` 的 `createUploadLinkAs` 新增的那段拒绝；`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 新方法 `judgeFieldWriteLock`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/record-file-access.integration.test.ts`，预期 36/36 通过，其中「minting refuses a field whose readonlyWhen holds now」一条绿。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 是收紧（narrowing），按车队规则需要你一句话同意后席位才排队落地。

**BREAKING** for a caller that minted an upload link onto a file field while the field's `readonlyWhen` held.

- FROM: `create_upload_link` answered a link; the upload through it was refused when it arrived (`403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, "Nothing was attached: …", since #32734), after the person had picked and sent the file.
- TO: the call itself is refused, `403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, ``You cannot attach a file to OBJECT.FIELD: the field is read-only in the target record's current state (a TRUE `readonlyWhen` predicate).``, and no link row is written. The fix for a caller: mint the link once the record's state unlocks the field, or use the record's attachments, which carry no field lock and are unchanged.

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/objectql`** — `ObjectQL#judgeFieldWriteLock(object, id, field, { context })`, the one write-free judgement of "is this field writable on this record now" for its `readonlyWhen` lock. Its body (`engine-field-write-lock.ts`) runs the update's own conditional strip, `stripReadonlyWhenFields`, over the update's own inputs: the stored row from `readUpdatePriorRow` as `previous`, the master-detail header from `resolveMasterDetailParent` under the same gate (`hasParentScopedReadonlyWhenInPayload`), and a payload carrying the value the field holds now. It answers `null`, or `{ reason: 'readonly_when', phrase }`: the `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']` the update reports the field under, and the phrase `ReadonlyFieldRejectedError` uses for that reason (`readonlyDropReasonPhrase`, newly exported from `readonly-strict-errors.ts`, not from the package entry). A faulting predicate refuses as the write refuses; an unbound root holds the lock; a row the caller cannot read is `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`; a field with no `readonlyWhen` reads nothing. The facade method in `engine.ts` is a delegation in the shape `validate` uses. `FieldWriteLock` is exported as a type.
- **`@objectstack/service-storage`** — `createUploadLinkAs`, for a file-field target, asks `engine.judgeFieldWriteLock` after the static `readonly` refusal and before the approval lock, and refuses `403 FIELD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE` with the engine's phrase. No CEL is evaluated here. The member is optional on `RecordFileEngine`: an engine without it is not asked, and the upload's own strict write still refuses on arrival. **An attachments target (no field) is unchanged** — it carries no field lock and is not judged.
- **`@objectstack/mcp`** — the `create_upload_link` description names the new refusal. `packages/mcp/src/file-content.ts` is not touched: it only declares the bridge types; the issue-time refusals live in `service-storage` (measured, and declared on the re-posted claim 6847846915).
- **Docs** — `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`: which fields get no link, and with what answer.
- **Update preview (`engine.validate`, `ValidateDataResponse`)** — not changed. Its published limit (`readonlyWhen` is not run) stays as written, so no published preview surface widens. The new judgement is a separate method; its only widening is the method itself.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-field-write-lock.test.ts` (new, 7): locked with the update's reason and phrase; unlocked while the condition is false; a `parent`-scoped lock reads the header; each verdict cross-checked against what `engine.update` reports for the same field (`onFieldsDropped`, `readonly_when`); no `readonlyWhen` costs no read; a faulting predicate refuses as `ValidationError`; a missing row is `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` 404; no driver write and no strip warning in any case.
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/record-file-access.integration.test.ts` (+2): minting on an approved claim's `invoices` is refused 403 with the exact sentence and writes no link row; the same field on a draft gets a link, a static `readonly` field keeps its refusal word for word, and the attachments list of an approved claim still gets a link.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-mcp-record-files.dogfood.test.ts` (+1, the one dogfood pin, over the real MCP HTTP face): after approval `create_upload_link` is refused 403 with the engine's phrase and mints nothing, and `update_record` on the same field answers `droppedFields` with reason `readonly_when` naming it.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, report only (as the order names): the consume-side refusal and page text (#32734, done), several files per link (#32747), upload before the record exists (#32686).
- Named limits of the judgement, documented on the method: `beforeUpdate` hooks are not run (a hook that rewrites a field a predicate reads moves the write's verdict and not this one); a lock whose predicate reads the incoming value of its own field is judged against the value already stored.
- PR #32932 (same `area:files` door) touches none of these files.
